description: The valkey store is in OOM state
expected_root_cause: The Valkey cache instance has run out of memory (OOM), exhausting cache resources and degrading read performance.
expected_mitigation: Execute Cache Purge and Reset Runbook or scale up replica capacity.

description: Connection-heavy client pods pinned to one worker node fill Linux nf_conntrack state, causing fresh Hotel Reservation service requests from that node to time out while pods and services mostly remain healthy.
expected_root_cause: The Linux nf_conntrack table limit is exhausted on the node, preventing new network connections and causing timeout cascades.
expected_mitigation: Execute Connection Termination Runbook or drain traffic to redistribute the load.

description: Overloads Kafka queue while simultaneously introducing a consumer side delay leading to a lag spike
expected_root_cause: Message broker backlog triggered by consumer processing delay and an overloaded queue, leading to high message latency.
expected_mitigation: Scale consumer replicas and shed load from producers.

description: Flood the frontend with a large amount of requests
expected_root_cause: Massive incoming traffic spike overwhelms the frontend application layer, causing latency and timeouts.
expected_mitigation: Implement Load Shedding and Traffic Rate Limits to protect backend services.

description: By modifying Kubernetes Ingress rules to route traffic from specific paths to incorrect backend services, simulates request misrouting issues caused by network routing configuration errors or load balancing misconfigurations.
expected_root_cause: Ingress configuration misroutes traffic to the wrong backends, acting like a load balancer misconfiguration.
expected_mitigation: Rollback Ingress configuration or initiate Traffic Failover to alternative ingress paths.

description: RPC module is misconfigured, then a load spike will trigger a retry storm
expected_root_cause: A massive surge in traffic causes RPC timeouts which amplifies load via aggressive retries, resulting in a retry storm.
expected_mitigation: Implement Rate Limiting and Load Shedding.

description: RPC module is misconfigured, then a CPU containment will trigger a retry storm
expected_root_cause: CPU starvation triggers RPC timeouts, which amplifies load via aggressive retries, resulting in a retry storm.
expected_mitigation: Increase CPU capacity and implement rate limiting.
